entities.summary: Katai Tayama was a Japanese author. His most famous works include Inaka Kyōshi and Futon. He is noted for establishing the Japanese literary genre of naturalistic I novels which revolve around the detailed self-examinations of an introspective author. He also wrote about his experiences in the Russo-Japanese War.
